$doc: The post-MVP tree's screen graph, the same grammar canonical's carries (backlog item 22). Every number has exactly one edge here, whose `to` lists every outcome: a board, a declared terminal, or an explicit gap. Boards named here live in this tree only — flow-markers.mjs is keyed by board name across every tree, so a post-MVP board never takes a canonical board's name. THE PAGE IS NOT WIRED, and deliberately: the settings boards are excerpts of canonical's Settings, so the rows on either side of the round's own group lead to boards this graph cannot name (readme §14 — a tree's graph stops at the tree). Only the round's own controls carry numbers; the rest take theirs when the round migrates into canonical and its edges become ordinary wiring.

terminals.back: Back — returns to the previous screen
terminals.self: Acts on this screen — state changes in place
terminals.os: Hands off to the OS — the platform's own permission ask, browser download, system sheet
terminals.canonical: Hands back to the MVP tree — a board this graph cannot name, because a tree's graph stops at the tree (readme §14). The destination exists and is drawn; it takes an ordinary edge the day this round migrates into canonical

scanExempt.HistoryMenu: the own-post sheet covers the post detail — everything beneath the scrim is inactive in this state; only the sheet (and its scrim) is live
scanExempt.VersionRemoveConfirm: the think-twice dialog covers the author's register — every row beneath the scrim is inactive in this state; only the dialog (and its scrim) is live
scanExempt.OpinionsRowDoors: the opinions sheet covers the post detail — everything beneath the scrim is inactive in this state; only the sheet (and its scrim) is live
scanExempt.StanceTimeline: the timeline sheet covers the opinions page — every row beneath the scrim is inactive in this state; only the sheet (and its scrim) is live, and it is a reading surface with nothing to act on
scanExempt.StanceTimelinePost: the timeline sheet covers the post detail — everything beneath the scrim is inactive in this state; only the sheet (and its scrim) is live
scanExempt.PadHistoryDoor: the scrim wash covers the shell — the back arrow, the post card's own controls and the nav are inactive in this state; only the parked pad is live
scanExempt.TimelineHelp: the "?" dialog covers the timeline sheet, which covers the opinions page — two washes deep, and only the dialog (and its scrim) is live

entries.PushSettings: the settings page at the notifications group — this round's excerpt of canonical's Settings, not a screen of its own
entries.NotificationsOffer: the notifications list as a reader who has never been asked about push meets it — a state the account arrives in, not a tap

entries.CommentHistory: the comment's ⋮ in the thread, whose roster gains the same row the post's does — a menu this graph cannot name, because it lives in canonical
entries.ProfileHistory: the profile's ⋮, whose roster gains the same row — likewise a canonical menu
entries.CommentHistoryOwn: your own comment's ⋮ in the thread, whose roster gains the same Edit history row — a canonical menu, so its author lands on the register
entries.ProfileHistoryOwn: your own profile's ⋮, whose roster gains the row — a canonical menu, so its owner lands on the register
entries.OpinionsRowDoors: the opinions count on a post's detail, which opens this sheet — this round's excerpt of canonical's `PostOpinions`, drawn for the split its rows gain
entries.ProfileStancesDoors: a profile's figures row, which opens the opinions page — this round's excerpt of canonical's `ProfileStances`, drawn for the same split
entries.PadHistoryDoor: a stance face, tapped anywhere a stance face is drawn — the pad is a cross-cutting overlay, and the shell beneath it is the everyday one rather than the state's own
entries.ChatsHome: the band's chats icon, on every tab root — canonical's band, which this graph cannot name; until the round migrates the icon opens `ChatsComingSoon` there
entries.ChatThreadInvited: the invitation's notification row — round B3's, the kind does not exist yet; every route to an invitation lands on this face
entries.ChatThreadApproved: the requester's chat once a member approves — a state the chat arrives in; the approval's notification row is round B3's
